label: clara-kds-progress-browser
notes: Vite on 127.0.0.1:5174 serving the KDS worktree, backend on 8080; KDS board at 1920x1080 (docs/ui/10 KDS size), C-08 at 390px; raw STOMP listeners for two tables.

results.name: KDS browser: C-08 shows the live connection state
KDS browser: KDS page uses the dark background #241C18
KDS browser: check box is at least 40×40
KDS browser: KDS page has no horizontal overflow at 1920×1080
KDS browser: a newly submitted order appears on the board within 1 second (submit included)
KDS browser: ticking an item updates C-08 without reloading
KDS browser: table guest receives ITEM_SERVED {ticketId, itemId, servedAt} with serverTime
KDS browser: event has no top-level sessionId (not mistaken for a cart change)
KDS browser: a ticket waiting over 15 minutes shows 久候 and a red border
KDS browser: waste dialog calls the waste API
KDS browser: C-08 shows the wasted item as 已退菜 without reloading
KDS browser: database marks the item wasted with the reason
KDS browser: ticket with everything served or wasted leaves the board
KDS browser: 整單出完 fades the card out and removes it
KDS browser: 整單出完 marks every item served
KDS browser: guest ITEM_WASTED carries no staff-written reason
KDS browser: table A guest got ITEM_WASTED and TICKET_SERVED
KDS browser: table B guest got none of table A kitchen events
KDS browser: no page errors or API 5xx
